import ctypes
import numpy as np

# Load the GSL libraries
ctypes.CDLL('/usr/local/gsl/lib/libgslcblas.so', mode=ctypes.RTLD_GLOBAL)
gsl = ctypes.CDLL('/usr/local/gsl/lib/libgsl.so')

# Define the function
def compute_eigen_gensymmv(A, B):
    n = A.shape[0]
    assert A.shape == (n, n), 'Matrix A must be square'
    assert B.shape == (n, n), 'Matrix B must be square'

    # Create GSL matrix and vector types
    gsl_matrix_alloc = gsl.gsl_matrix_alloc
    gsl_matrix_alloc.argtypes = [ctypes.c_size_t, ctypes.c_size_t]
    gsl_matrix_alloc.restype = ctypes.POINTER(ctypes.c_void_p)

    gsl_vector_alloc = gsl.gsl_vector_alloc
    gsl_vector_alloc.argtypes = [ctypes.c_size_t]
    gsl_vector_alloc.restype = ctypes.POINTER(ctypes.c_void_p)

    gsl_eigen_gensymmv_alloc = gsl.gsl_eigen_gensymmv_alloc
    gsl_eigen_gensymmv_alloc.argtypes = [ctypes.c_size_t]
    gsl_eigen_gensymmv_alloc.restype = ctypes.POINTER(ctypes.c_void_p)

    gsl_eigen_gensymmv = gsl.gsl_eigen_gensymmv
    gsl_eigen_gensymmv.argtypes = [ctypes.POINTER(ctypes.c_void_p), ctypes.POINTER(ctypes.c_void_p), ctypes.POINTER(ctypes.c_void_p), ctypes.POINTER(ctypes.c_void_p), ctypes.POINTER(ctypes.c_void_p)]
    gsl_eigen_gensymmv.restype = ctypes.c_int

    gsl_matrix_set = gsl.gsl_matrix_set
    gsl_matrix_set.argtypes = [ctypes.POINTER(ctypes.c_void_p), ctypes.c_size_t, ctypes.c_size_t, ctypes.c_double]

    gsl_matrix_get = gsl.gsl_matrix_get
    gsl_matrix_get.argtypes = [ctypes.POINTER(ctypes.c_void_p), ctypes.c_size_t, ctypes.c_size_t]
    gsl_matrix_get.restype = ctypes.c_double

    gsl_vector_get = gsl.gsl_vector_get
    gsl_vector_get.argtypes = [ctypes.POINTER(ctypes.c_void_p), ctypes.c_size_t]
    gsl_vector_get.restype = ctypes.c_double

    gsl_matrix_free = gsl.gsl_matrix_free
    gsl_matrix_free.argtypes = [ctypes.POINTER(ctypes.c_void_p)]

    gsl_vector_free = gsl.gsl_vector_free
    gsl_vector_free.argtypes = [ctypes.POINTER(ctypes.c_void_p)]

    gsl_eigen_gensymmv_free = gsl.gsl_eigen_gensymmv_free
    gsl_eigen_gensymmv_free.argtypes = [ctypes.POINTER(ctypes.c_void_p)]

    # Allocate matrices and vectors
    A_gsl = gsl_matrix_alloc(n, n)
    B_gsl = gsl_matrix_alloc(n, n)
    eval_gsl = gsl_vector_alloc(n)
    evec_gsl = gsl_matrix_alloc(n, n)
    workspace = gsl_eigen_gensymmv_alloc(n)

    # Copy data to GSL matrices
    for i in range(n):
        for j in range(n):
            gsl_matrix_set(A_gsl, i, j, float(A[i, j]))
            gsl_matrix_set(B_gsl, i, j, float(B[i, j]))

    # Compute eigenvalues and eigenvectors
    status = gsl_eigen_gensymmv(A_gsl, B_gsl, eval_gsl, evec_gsl, workspace)
    assert status == 0, 'GSL computation failed'

    # Extract results
    evals = np.array([gsl_vector_get(eval_gsl, i) for i in range(n)])
    evecs = np.array([[gsl_matrix_get(evec_gsl, i, j) for j in range(n)] for i in range(n)])

    # Free allocated memory
    gsl_matrix_free(A_gsl)
    gsl_matrix_free(B_gsl)
    gsl_vector_free(eval_gsl)
    gsl_matrix_free(evec_gsl)
    gsl_eigen_gensymmv_free(workspace)

    return evals, evecs

# Test cases
def assert_test():
    A = np.array([[4.0, 1.0], [1.0, 3.0]])
    B = np.array([[1.0, 0.0], [0.0, 1.0]])
    evals, evecs = compute_eigen_gensymmv(A, B)
    assert evals.shape == (2,), 'Eigenvalues shape mismatch'
    assert evecs.shape == (2, 2), 'Eigenvectors shape mismatch'
    print('Test passed.')

if __name__ == '__main__':
    assert_test()
